behavior: Docs say the receipt never shows the settlement, PLAN 10.2 lists only the work left, and D-83 records EU, UK and US invoice rules first
acceptance: openapi.yaml and docs/web/PRODUCT.md say what the code does: the receipt PDF shows the paid time and the payments, never the settlement; the settlement does not change the receipt; the pay page becomes the payer's receipt once paid, not after settlement (R-48, R-61, R-68).
PLAN.md 10.2 lists only the work left (PO/reference with a default per saved client, duplicate, agreed value); line items, supply date and the due date's checkout close are done.

Decision D-83 records that invoice rules follow the EU, the UK and the US first, chosen by the issuer's and the client's countries, with per-country rules for other countries after the MVP; PLAN phase 10 and Deferred point to it.
notes: 2026-10-17 review fail by reviewer: 1) apps/backend/api/openapi.yaml:1511 (changed line) says 'a late deposit changes it'. In this repo a late deposit is one after expiresAt (openapi.yaml:1405-1407, R-21), and Receipt() skips it (document.go:171 'confirmed && !dep.Late'); invoices_pdf_test.go:327-337 checks the receipt leaves it out. So a late deposit does NOT change the receipt. Say 'a later deposit before the checkout closes changes it, the settlement does not'. Same wrong claim in docs/backend/api.md:216-217; fix both (same behavior, two places). 2) openapi.yaml:682 and docs/backend/api.md:211 say the receipt lists 'each confirmed deposit'; the code lists only confirmed deposits that are not late. Add 'made before the checkout closed' (or similar). 3) docs/PROJECT.md:223 D-83 cites 'NY GBL §1411-1414', but the research (phase-10-freelancers.md:227) read only §1411, §1412 and §1414; §1413 was not read. Write '§1411, §1412 and §1414'. 4) Minor: docs/web/PRODUCT.md:13 is 143 characters; the file wraps at about 120. Rewrap lines 13-14. OK: settlement is not on the receipt and does not change its bytes or ETag (document.go:158-178, pdf.go hashes the bytes, test at invoices_pdf_test.go:320-323); the pay page shows Paid for settled (pay-copy.ts:57, pay-invoice.tsx:219,373) and nothing about settlement; no other doc says the payer sees settlement; PLAN 10.2 lists only PO/reference, duplicate and agreed value, and R-88, R-89 and D-80 are done in PROJECT.md and code (F213-F215 passing); D-83 is defined once and cited from PLAN.md:41 and :152; tasks.json only adds F216; check-docs passes.

2026-10-17 review pass by reviewer: All four earlier findings are fixed. 1) Late deposit: openapi.yaml:1512-1513 and docs/backend/api.md:217-218 now say another deposit before the checkout closes changes the receipt and a late deposit and the settlement do not. This matches Receipt() (document.go:171 lists only confirmed && !dep.Late; Late = block time after expiresAt, get.go:158), pdf.go:36-39 (ETag is a hash of the bytes) and invoices_pdf_test.go (304 with the paid ETag after settling; a late deposit is not in the receipt). 2) openapi.yaml:682 and api.md:211-212 now say each confirmed deposit made before the checkout closed. inv.Deposits is the chosen option's deposits only (get.go:75-81), so other-option money is not listed either. 3) D-83 (PROJECT.md:223) now cites NY GBL §1411, §1412 and §1414. Every source it names (VAT Directive art. 91, 220, 226, 230; GOV.UK; HMRC VAT Notice 700; IRS FAQ A10) is in phase-10-freelancers.md:221-228. 4) PRODUCT.md:13-14 now fit 120 characters. Also checked: the pay page shows Paid for paid and settled (pay-invoice.tsx:219,373; pay-copy.ts:57) and never mentions the settlement, so PRODUCT.md:13-14 is right. openapi.yaml still parses (block scalar ok), and the settled time is correctly gone from the receipt description. The word diff shows rewraps changed no meaning. Every added line fits 120 characters (PROJECT.md table rows are long by design). The diff touches only the 6 task files, and tasks.json only adds F216 and nextId. D-83 is cited from PLAN.md:41 and :152. check-docs: 0 errors. Not blocking: (a) PLAN.md:153 leaves a short line before 'Card payers'; this is only style. (b) Money sent after the invoice is paid but before the close is held as excess (R-21), yet the receipt still lists it as a payment. The docs describe this code correctly; whether the receipt should list it is a product question for later.

proof.1: docs-check: openapi.yaml getReceiptPdf lists paid time, confirmed deposits made before the checkout closed and the pay link, and says it never shows the settlement (R-61, R-68); its Cache-Control and docs/backend/api.md say another deposit before the close changes the receipt, a late deposit and the settlement do not, matching document.Receipt() and TestReceiptPDF; docs/web/PRODUCT.md says the pay page is the payer's receipt once paid (R-48)
proof.2: docs-check: PLAN.md 10.2 now lists PO/reference with a default per saved client, duplicate and the agreed value only
proof.3: docs-check: docs/PROJECT.md D-83 (EU, UK and US rules first, from the issuer's and the client's countries; other countries after the MVP; sources as read in the research); PLAN phase 10 intro and Deferred cite D-83
